text:
maya (Product PM): Quick sync: need to finalize launch plan for Adaptive Routing V1. Product wants GA by May 12. Can eng/runtime/infra/security commit to sequence? TL;DR: runtime needs kernel changes, infra needs capacity, security needs KMS review.

alex (Eng Runtime): We can target the date but need to land two runtime PRs: continuous-batching v2 and KV-cache eviction. Risk: kernel selection for A100s vs H100s across regions.

sam (Infra Eng): Infra needs 2x more GPU hosts on Dedicated pool and a VPC peering change. Estimate: 4 weeks if no blockers.

riley (Security): Security: KMS key rotation + audit logs must be in place for Private customers. Need design spec + threat model. 2 weeks after spec.

zoe (Prod Design): Product acceptance criteria: 95th p latency <= 120ms on 2k TPS synthetic + auto-fallback to smaller model on overload. Also need canary criteria and UX for rollback notices.

maya (Product PM): Propose a sequencing: week 1 runtime PRs + infra capacity request; week 2 security spec; week 3 canary on staging; week 4 GA. Is that realistic?

alex (Eng Runtime): Week 1 ok for PRs but kernel rollout across regions adds 1 week. Also require perf CI baseline before canary. So shift to 5-week conservative plan.

sam (Infra Eng): If infra gets approval for burst capacity we can parallelize and keep 4 weeks. Need signed PO for Reserved capacity to book hosts.

riley (Security): I'll start threat model doc now. Can someone tag the compliance case owner? @maya

maya (Product PM): @riley assigned to AuditOps: emma. Emma, can you own compliance sign-off path?

emma (AuditOps): Got it. I'll review KMS spec and confirm controls. ETA 10 business days.

alex (Eng Runtime): Action items: runtime to open PRs by EOD Tue (PR links will be posted). perf CI job name: `perf-ci/adaptive-routing`. Acceptance tests: product to provide 30 prompt set + SLO checklist.

zoe (Prod Design): I'll upload the prompt set by Friday and add canary gating doc in the PR. Canary gating: 0.5% traffic -> monitor latency & error rate -> expand to 10% if stable for 3h.

dev-bot (deploy-bot): deployment scheduled: canary-window 2026-05-03T08:00Z -> 2026-05-05T08:00Z (automated placeholder).

maya (Product PM): Let's vote. If everyone agrees to the 5-week conservative plan, we lock scope (no extra features) and start. :thumbsup: to agree.

alex (Eng Runtime): :thumbsup: for 5-week conservative plan

sam (Infra Eng): :thumbsup: but need PO to finalize

riley (Security): :thumbsup: starting spec

emma (AuditOps): :thumbsup: will do compliance runway

maya (Product PM): Summary of next steps: 1) Runtime opens PRs by EOD Tue. 2) Infra requests PO & provision burst capacity. 3) Security drafts threat model and KMS spec. 4) Product delivers prompt set + acceptance tests. 5) Perf CI baseline before canary. I'll update roadmap doc and send a calendar invite for weekly triage.

sam (Infra Eng): Noted. I'll kick off the infra ticket and ping finance for the PO.

alex (Eng Runtime): Will post PR links and initial perf numbers tomorrow.

maya (Product PM): Thanks team — keeping scope locked is critical. We'll revisit if showstopper bugs pop up during canary.

(reacts: :white_check_mark: from alex, sam, riley)
